Athletic Club Omonoia Nicosia, commonly known as Omonoia Nicosia, or simply Omonoia, is a Cypriot professional multi-sport club, established on 4 June 1948 in Nicosia. It is best known for its football department, which has participated in the Cypriot First Division since 1953. On 14 June 2018, the football department of AC Omonoia became a professional for-profit football company, and is since known as Omonoia FC.
